title: 3.12 Have and Has
unit_title: Unit 3: Me, You and Other People
unit_outcome: Greet people, say who you are, your age, where you are from and your job, and say what belongs to whom.
goal: Say who has what with habe, hast, hat and haben, and whose thing it is: Das ist mein Auto.
grammar_function: Subject + hat/haben + ein/mein + noun. Das ist mein/dein/unser + noun.
speaking_outcome: Say who has what and whose it is.
